name: Greg Roman's Power Read & QB Run Attack
description: The most quarterback-centric gap-scheme system in modern football, built on heavy 22 personnel and the unblocked-read-key geometry that made Lamar Jackson an MVP. Greg Roman packages power read pulls, designed QB power keepers, pin-and-pull perimeter leverage, and identical-picture play-action shots so that every defensive run fit is simultaneously a pass-fit decision — and heavy personnel becomes an offensive weapon instead of a tell.
